text: Beacon Fires of the Eight Dynasties

[[img:icon_great_bastion]][[/img]]The Celestial Empire of Cathay spans a vast realm; throughout its long struggle against foreign foes, countless regional forces that preserved their traditions once fought alongside the Dragon Emperor's Jade Warrior legions, achieving countless victories. Now, under the guidance of the Dragon Princes, these echoes of the past shall find new life once more.\\n\\n [[img:icon_great_bastion]][[/img]] [[col:green]]These regional forces will only answer your call once you control the corresponding province's capital and have constructed the landmark building[[/col]]\\n\\n[[img:icon_great_bastion]][[/img]]Note: if you choose to begin as [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/flag_cth_north.png]][[/img]][[col:green]]the Northern Provinces, [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/flag_cth_west.png]][[/img]]the Western Provinces, [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/flag_cth_south.png]][[/img]]the Burning Wind Nomads, or [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/flag_cth_east.png]][[/img]]the Lords of the Eastern River[[/col]], you [[col:green]]do not need to construct your own faction's landmark[[/col]] to automatically unlock your faction's signature units. Only when recruiting special units belonging to another faction do you need to capture that faction's capital and construct the corresponding landmark.
